verdict.rationale: n8n documents an OEM deployment option for embedding and surfacing its interface inside your own product's UI, which covers the core embedding story. It requires a separate commercial agreement, and the evidence never explicitly describes white-label rebranding. missing for 10: explicit white-label/rebranding documentation, details on multi-tenant customer provisioning, independent or hands-on corroboration of OEM embedding.

support.subject: As a developer, I can embed the automation platform white-label inside my own product for my customers

citations.quote: n8n's OEM deployment option lets you embed and surface n8n's interface inside your own product's UI.
OEM deployment of n8n requires a separate commercial agreement with n8n.
